sources.title: Квалификационный экзамен: задача по обмотке статора 6А90В4

notes: The qualification source explicitly names 6А90В4 and gives effective slot conductors uп=70, phase turns w1=420, parallel branches a1=1 and nominal stator current 2.0 A.
The following task sentence in that source says to select wire for 6А80В4; this is preserved as a source-text conflict and is not silently normalized.
The separate 6A 80-90 winding-data article confirms this family table is for 380 V with star-connected phases, but its detailed rows are image-only in the current web extraction.
No wire diameter, coil_program, coil turns, pitch or slot count is inferred from uп or w1.

records.source_text_conflict: Problem statement names 6А90В4 in the given data but later asks to select wire for 6А80В4.
